# k0rdent_instance (Data Source)

One instance, a host an instance group holds, read by id.

A deleted instance is an error here, as the platform answers 410 for it. Its `network_interfaces` carry the `mac_address` or `guid` that narrows a `k0rdent_file_store` grant to one interface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One host, by the id k0rdent_instances reports.
data "k0rdent_instance" "head" {
  id = "inst-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
}

# Its InfiniBand GUIDs, for a file store grant's `guid`.
output "infiniband_guids" {
  value = [for nic in data.k0rdent_instance.head.network_interfaces : nic.guid if nic.type == "infiniband"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Instance id, as `k0rdent_instances` reports it. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL. Must be inst- and 32 lower-case hex digits, as the instances data source reports it.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project to read. Defaults to the provider's `project`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.
- `region` (String) Region to read. Defaults to the provider's `region`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the instance was created, as RFC 3339.
- `health` (String) Host health as the infrastructure service observes it: `healthy`, `degraded`, `unhealthy` or `unknown`. Separate from `state`: a `running` host can be `unhealthy`.
- `hostname` (String) The host's effective hostname right now. Usually `server_slug`.
- `instance_group` (String) Id of the instance group that holds this host, the value a file store grant's `ref` takes.
- `last_power_action_error` (String) Why the most recent power action on the host's machine is known to have failed, whether it was sent by `k0rdent_instance_power` or by an operator on the machine directly. Null when no failure is known, which is also how a power action that succeeded reads: the platform doesn't report success. Separate from `state`.
- `network_interfaces` (Attributes List) The host's runtime network interfaces, as the infrastructure service reports them now. Empty until the host is provisioned. An Ethernet interface carries `mac_address` and an InfiniBand one carries `guid`, the two values a `k0rdent_file_store` grant's `consumers.network` takes to narrow it to one interface. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_interfaces))
- `node_pool` (String) The group's node pool this host was provisioned into.
- `self_link` (String) Platform-defined reference to this instance.
- `server_slug` (String) The host's registered name.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state, read from the host on every request: `not_provisioned`, `provisioning`, `running`, `deprovisioning`, `deleting`, `degraded` or `unknown`.
- `state_message` (String) Why the instance is in `state`. Null while `running`.
- `uid` (String) The same identity as `id`, in UUID form.

<a id="nestedatt--network_interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `guid` (String) GUID of an InfiniBand interface, in the `0x`-prefixed form a file store grant's `guid` takes. Null on Ethernet.
- `ip_addresses` (List of String) Addresses assigned to the interface now.
- `mac_address` (String) Hardware address of an Ethernet interface, in the colon-separated form a file store grant's `mac_address` takes. Null on InfiniBand.
- `type` (String) `ethernet` or `infiniband`.

## Related

- [`k0rdent_instances`](../data-sources/instances.md) data source: lists every one.
- [`k0rdent_instance_group`](../resources/instance_group.md) resource: manages the group the host belongs to.
- [`k0rdent_file_store`](../resources/file_store.md) resource: grants a host by the addresses read here.
